# Laos OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

National outreach package covering **1 catalogued cities**. Values
below aggregate city screening models; the national brief separately treats the
shared manufacturing plant.

## Audience

- Laos ministry responsible for transport and urban mobility
- Laos national climate, energy or Green Climate Fund authority
- Laos public investment, planning or finance authority
- Embassy or High Commission of Laos in the United Kingdom — economic section
